cases.setup: Provide a pinned public Python analyzer checkout, hashed anchors, and a bound public reproduction command. Scope and test owner locations may initially be unknown.
checks: The record identifies actual current scope and annotation-test owners.
The record contains the ordinary function registry representation, asynchronous registration status, version policy, and relevant argument-binding scope path.
The public reproduction record includes source, bound argv, and actual diagnostic or exception outcome.
Tracked code and test hashes remain unchanged.
An applicability-established PortValue is emitted only when current evidence connects missing registration to the failure; otherwise the result is insufficient or not applicable.

cases.setup: Supply an applicability-established diagnosis, evidence-backed PASS prerequisites, current owner bindings, reviewed registry representation, and supported-version policy.
checks: The diff adds asynchronous-function registration with the representation used for ordinary functions.
The regression includes a module class and identically named annotated asynchronous parameter, a None return annotation, and appropriate syntax-version gating.
The diff neither adds a blanket parent-traversal fallback nor weakens neighboring diagnostic assertions.
The prior public-validation observation is marked stale without invalidating required behavior assurances.
The explicit validate Action remains in the verification closure.

cases.setup: Supply the unvalidated code-and-test change and current public Oracle bindings for the reproduction and repository annotation checks.
checks: Rendered current argv commands and actual execution outcomes are recorded.
The reproduction outcome shows whether analysis completes without the Module.parent crash and without unexpected diagnostics.
The new regression and neighboring annotation tests have actual recorded outcomes.
An ordinary-function counterpart is compared against its prior behavior.
Supported-version gate review or runtime probes are recorded; unavailable runtime checks remain UNKNOWN.
Validation does not modify source or weaken test expectations.
Failures or unknown assurances prevent reporting full Workflow success.
Changed-test-only historical qualification is not presented as whole-project or cross-project validation.
